prompts.safety.pii.short: What data shouldn't I put in an AI prompt for [task]?
prompts.safety.pii.detailed: I want AI help with [task]. The original text had personal data, so I replaced it with labels like “Person A”, “City”, “Date”. Here's the result: [text with labels]. Check whether anything could still identify someone: unusual job titles, exact dates, names of small organisations, combinations of details. Suggest what else to replace.
prompts.safety.pii.refine: Make me a 10-point reminder: what never to paste into an AI chat.
prompts.safety.pii.check: How can I phrase my task [task] with no personal data at all, while still getting a useful answer?
prompts.safety.verify.short: What in this AI answer should I check? [answer]
prompts.safety.verify.detailed: Here's the answer I got from an AI to “[question]”: [answer]. List what needs checking: facts, numbers, dates, names, quotes, links, advice affecting money, health or documents. For each, why it's questionable and where to check. Don't correct the answer yourself.
prompts.safety.verify.refine: Rank the items by risk: what happens if each turns out to be false.
prompts.safety.verify.check: I checked item [number] and found: [findings]. What does that mean for the rest of the answer?
prompts.safety.source.short: What questions should I ask about this source: [source]?
prompts.safety.source.detailed: Help me assess this source: [source]. Write the questions to ask and where to find the answers: who the author is and their expertise, who the publisher is, when it was published and updated, what it cites, whether there's advertising or a vested interest, what other independent sources say, whether there are emotional headlines instead of facts.
prompts.safety.source.refine: Here's what I found out: [answers]. How far can I trust this source?
prompts.safety.source.check: Find signs of manipulation in the source text: [text]
prompts.safety.bias.short: Is there bias or stereotyping in this text? [text]
prompts.safety.bias.detailed: Check the text for bias: generalisations about groups, one-sided choice of examples, loaded words instead of facts, missing viewpoints, assumptions that “everyone thinks so”. For each, quote it, explain the problem and offer a neutral wording. If you're unsure, mark it “possibly”. Text: [text]
prompts.safety.bias.refine: Whose viewpoint is missing from the text? How can it be added fairly?
prompts.safety.bias.check: Rewrite paragraph [number] neutrally and show what changed.
prompts.safety.image.short: What are the risks of posting this image: [description]?
prompts.safety.image.detailed: I want to post an image: [description, no personal data]. Where: [where]. Help me check the risks: recognisable people and their consent, children, car and house numbers, documents and screens in shot, geotags and metadata, others' rights to the image, whether it could mislead if AI-generated. For each, how to reduce the risk.
prompts.safety.image.refine: How do I remove geotags and metadata from a photo on my phone? Describe the general steps.
prompts.safety.image.check: Help me write a short request for consent to post a photo.
prompts.safety.label.short: How should I label material made with AI: [what it is]?
prompts.safety.label.detailed: I made [what it is] with AI help: [what the AI did, what I did]. Suggest 3 honest labels of different lengths: for school work, for social media, for an image caption. Neither downplaying nor exaggerating the AI's role. Suggest where to place it.
prompts.safety.label.refine: My teacher wants a detailed description of how I used AI. Help me write the paragraph.
prompts.safety.label.check: My label: [label]. Could it mislead anyone?
prompts.safety.consent.short: Can I use someone else's material [what] in my project?
prompts.safety.consent.detailed: I want to use someone else's material in [project]: [what: a photo, text, music, a voice, a person's face]. List the questions to answer first: who the author is, what licence, educational or public use, whether credit is required, whether the person shown must give permission, whether it can be modified. Add a template for politely asking permission.
prompts.safety.consent.refine: Where can I find similar material with a free licence? Name types of sources.
prompts.safety.consent.check: Help me write a proper credit line for [material].
prompts.safety.harm.short: Could this material harm its audience? [material]
prompts.safety.harm.detailed: I'm about to publish [what] for [audience]. Text or description: [material]. Check for possible harm: dangerous advice people might follow, unreliable health or money information, hurtful wording, exposing others' data, distressing content without a warning. For each, how to fix it.
prompts.safety.harm.refine: How can I add a content warning without scaring readers off?
prompts.safety.harm.check: How would someone personally affected by this read it?
prompts.safety.safer.short: Rewrite my AI prompt to be safer: [prompt]
prompts.safety.safer.detailed: Here's my AI prompt: [prompt]. Rewrite it so that: it contains no personal data (use labels instead), it asks the AI to flag uncertainty and give sources, it says “don't make things up if you don't know”, and for health, legal or money topics it notes that a specialist is needed. Explain each change.
prompts.safety.safer.refine: Make a short safe-prompt template I can reuse every time.
prompts.safety.safer.check: Compare my original and new prompt: what was I at risk of revealing?
prompts.safety.human.short: When is it better to ask a person rather than AI about [topic]?
prompts.safety.human.detailed: I have a question about [topic]. Explain: when AI can help (understanding terms, preparing questions, making a plan) and when a person is needed: a doctor, lawyer, psychologist, teacher, parent, bank specialist, support service. For each case, the signs it's time for a person and how to prepare for the conversation.
prompts.safety.human.refine: Help me write a list of questions for a specialist about my situation: [situation, no personal data]
prompts.safety.human.check: An AI gave me this advice: [advice]. Can I follow it without consulting a specialist?

verify.safety.pii: Check before sending, not after. If in doubt, take it out.
verify.safety.verify: The most important check is against the original source: an official site, a document, a textbook.
verify.safety.source: No single sign guarantees reliability. Look at the overall picture and compare with other sources.
verify.safety.bias: AI may not notice its own bias. Compare the answer with sources representing different viewpoints.
verify.safety.image: Get consent before posting photos of people, especially children. It's almost impossible to remove an image from the internet completely.
verify.safety.label: Check the platform's and your school's rules: in some places labelling AI use is required.
verify.safety.consent: This isn't legal advice. If in doubt, ask the author directly or consult a lawyer.
verify.safety.harm: If the material concerns health, money or safety, show it to a specialist before publishing.
verify.safety.safer: A safe prompt doesn't guarantee a safe answer. Still check the response.
verify.safety.human: If the situation is urgent or dangerous, don't wait for an AI answer: call emergency services.
